fast_path.eligibility: No new web endpoints, auth flows, package dependencies, or user-facing data processing.
fast_path.dispatch_prompt_addendum: Fast-path mode: this changeset has no runtime code surface. Scope the review to secrets-in-content, shell-injection patterns, and dependency metadata. Skip full STRIDE/OWASP threat modeling unless you discover runtime exposure.

schema_inventory_grep_scope.dispatch_prompt_addendum: For schema or rename inventories, search source, docs, config, and scripts explicitly: rg -n '<token>' . --glob '*.md' --glob '*.json' --glob '*.toml' --glob '*.yaml' --glob '*.yml' --glob '*.js' --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.tsx' --glob '*.py' --glob '*.sh'. Confirm README.md and changelogs were checked.

classifier_outage.dispatch_prompt_addendum: If Write/Edit is blocked by a transient classifier error while editing Markdown definition files under agents/, skills/, or workflows/, use safe shell-based patch application in your own workspace only. Continue to respect owned_files and emit files_written accurately.
